name: How long does it take to repair water damage around a window?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair water damage around a window?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of water damage repair around a window depends on the severity. Minor repairs, such as recaulking and repainting, typically take less than a day. If the damage requires replacing sections of drywall, insulation, or wood framing, the process could take 1-3 days, including drying time for new materials. For more extensive issues involving structural repairs or mold remediation, the project might extend to a week or more. The overall timeline also includes assessment, material procurement, and proper drying to prevent future issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time ranges from less than a day for minor fixes to a week or more for extensive structural or mold damage.
